# Samuel Listens to God (1 Samuel 3:10)

## Emotional Focus
When you’re not sure what to do and need to listen quietly for God.

## Key KJV
“Speak; for thy servant heareth.” (1 Samuel 3:10)

## Gentle Retelling
Young Samuel heard his name called at night. He thought it was Eli, but it was God speaking. Samuel learned to say, “Speak, Lord, I am listening.” He obeyed and God used him in wonderful ways.

## Coloring Prompt
Young Samuel sitting up in bed at night with soft lamp light, listening quietly and peacefully.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“God loves to talk to you. You can say, ‘Speak, Lord, I’m listening.’”
